criterion: which COVID-19-related user intent the utterance expresses

categories.name: Case and Death Statistics
categories.definition: Requests for specific numbers regarding infections, deaths, testing rates, or recovery counts in specific locations or demographics.

categories.name: Symptoms and Diagnosis
categories.definition: Inquiries about specific symptoms of COVID-19, how to identify them, or how to distinguish the virus from other illnesses like the flu or allergies.

categories.name: Transmission and Surface Survival
categories.definition: Questions regarding how the virus spreads, survival time on specific surfaces, or transmission risks from animals, objects, or specific activities.

categories.name: Prevention and Protection
categories.definition: Requests for advice on protective measures, hygiene practices, or safety precautions to avoid contracting or spreading the virus.

categories.name: Treatment and Cure
categories.definition: Questions about medical treatments, home remedies, vaccines, or the existence of a cure for COVID-19.

categories.name: Travel Advice and Restrictions
categories.definition: Questions concerning the safety of travel, travel bans, restrictions for specific destinations, or transportation guidelines.

categories.name: News and Updates
categories.definition: Requests for general news updates, press releases, or the current status of the pandemic in specific locations.

categories.name: Myths and Misinformation
categories.definition: Inquiries verifying specific rumors, myths, or unverified claims regarding the origin, nature, or prevention of the virus.

categories.name: Pets and Animals
categories.definition: Questions specifically regarding the susceptibility, symptoms, or transmission of the virus in pets, livestock, or wildlife.

categories.name: Donations and Relief Funds
categories.definition: Requests to donate money or find information about contributing to relief funds and charitable organizations.

categories.name: Sharing and Social Media
categories.definition: Requests to share the service, information, or links via social media or direct messaging.

categories.name: Greetings and Gratitude
categories.definition: Utterances consisting of greetings, thanks, or other social pleasantries directed at the bot.

categories.name: General Information
categories.definition: Broad requests for information about the virus or pandemic that do not fit into a specific category like stats or symptoms.
